name: Takei Ryouka
source:
She's the daughter of a family that has served Suwa Shrine for generations.

Her hobby is making desserts. She has an attractive figure, which she and everyone else around her is well aware.

Her main weapon is a Naginata. https://www.debonosu.jp/debo/game/reimeiki_22/index.html
